records.surface: SolvBTC beacon upgrades behind a 3d TimelockController (docs: timelock 'will be added')
records.onchain_observed: SolvBTC is a beacon proxy: EIP-1967 beacon slot = 0xFc335FdA7E6a33329A83F4d5F578eC7d8A43DC4A (implementation() = 0xA4b6cf2BAaA235ab7Fe10EADB84b82460165B38F). The beacon's owner() = 0x443628281E4f3E5b5A5D029B9a0D13900ae41578, whose admin() = TimelockController (0xfd4B809AD88db6Ca9dbB295A4B9d23bB0093f497, pendingAdmin() = 0) with getMinDelay() = 259200s (3d); the 3-of-5 Safe 0x0c2Bc4d2698820e12E6eBe863E7b9E2650CD5b7D holds PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE, and the timelock holds its own DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. The beacon owner's admin semantics are read from its admin() / pendingAdmin() getters (source not reviewed).
records.documented_reference: docs.solv.finance/llms-full.txt: 'The admin privileges for upgrades are assigned to a Gnosis Safe multi-signature address ... The timelock mechanism will be added to further enhance security by introducing a delay between the upgrade proposal and execution.'
